# contentful_app_jwt (Ephemeral Resource)

Signs an RS256 JWT locally with the app's private key. The JWT expires after ten minutes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "app_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

ephemeral "contentful_app_jwt" "editorial" {
  app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
  private_key       = var.app_private_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_definition_id` (String) App definition ID used as the JWT issuer.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Unencrypted RSA private key of at least 2048 bits in PKCS#1 or PKCS#8 PEM format.

### Read-Only

- `jwt` (String, Sensitive) RS256-signed JWT for the app definition.
